_comment: Which of mxm-creative-sampler's parameters fill the collection's control roles.
Roles come from docs/MXM_CONTROL_MAP.md, which is normative; parameters are named by
their permanent string id, never by display name.
THIS MAP CLAIMS ONLY ROLES THE STANDARD ALREADY DECLARES, and that leaves the whole
instrument-defining surface off it: Blend, Character and its four stages, the region and
loop extents, scan speed, every grain control, and the four macros. An instrument map
naming a role the player's compiled standard does not declare is refused WHOLE - not just
that entry - so minting sampler roles here would cost this instrument every mapping below
on any player built before they existed. Section 9 of MXM_CONTROL_MAP.md is the rule, and
mxm-mono-03 and mxm-poly-06 ship restricted maps for the same reason.
Sampler roles - a granular page with size, rate, position and pitch variation, and a source
page with the region extents - are a change to the standard, the compiled data and the
player together, made once and claimed here afterwards. They are not this file's to invent.
NOTHING MASQUERADES. plan-mxm-creative-sampler.md section 3 forbids dressing the playback
mode up as osc1.wave or the grain controls as an effect's, so a role is filled only where
the parameter genuinely is the thing the role names. A layer's transpose is an oscillator's
tune and a layer's trim is a mixer source's level; a layer's playback mode is neither.
The ids are provisional until the S3 listening gate, as plugins/mxm-creative-sampler/
AGENTS.md records. This file moves with them.
